name: inner_event_repair
source_selection: Every one of the six corporate actions in the frozen status-followup inner-trial queue, independent of subsequent returns. Do not extend the event queue or change any strategy candidate during this run.
scope: Apply six sourced cash payment dates, one unrestricted-share listing date and the explicitly reviewed ex-reference values. Preserve actual entitlements, raw prices, all dated ST metadata, calendar, universe, non-label columns and feature contract. Rebuild all labels; do not extend market dates.
cash_availability: First observed trading session strictly after the sourced payment date; not a statement of intraday simulator cash availability.
risk: Balanced attack; latched 4/6/8 percent drawdown stages; original high-water mark; no automatic recovery.

retraining.selection: All existing candidates, calibration and adoption thresholds unchanged; inner validation only.

comparison: Compare every model, saved forecast array and candidate/rule choice. If all forecast arrays and choices are exactly equal, the full new evaluation also serves as the fixed-forecast data bridge; otherwise replay all 1425 fixed-old-forecast accounts separately before attributing retraining changes.
verification: Check original frozen bytes, exact raw/metadata/calendar/non-label parity, all labels, 48 model reloads, every outer account with independent cash and execution audits, before/after inner-trial quality and model adoption, and 75 paper accounts. Reverify the ten ST intervals and bind any nonblocking status decision to the new dataset hash.
adoption: Retain every source-verified correction regardless of return direction. Activate research inputs only after the registered checks complete. No claim of superiority or valid next-day advice follows from engineering validation.
suspension_handling: Do not infer pre-open availability, fill missing bars or clear carried-price quality flags for the five source-confirmed sz002348 suspended sessions. Store their retrospective evidence separately; flags may only disappear naturally if a different simulated path no longer holds the stock.
limitations: Retrospective repair on repeatedly inspected windows; no independent forward observations.
Unreviewed corporate actions, fractional-share allocation, historical industry/universe coverage and security statuses remain incomplete.
Retrospective suspension notices and daily provider flags do not establish historical pre-open availability.
Opening prices remain proxies; competition fee and matching details are unconfirmed.
The market cutoff remains 2026-11-19; a valid next-day plan requires complete current market data and a matching account.
